rows.en: I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! Through your defeat...!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove it right now!! With your defeat!!
I'll prove that right now!! Through your defeat!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll put a stop to your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We're stoppin' that ambition of yours!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We're gonna stop that ambition of yours!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll put a stop to your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We will eradicate your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We will eliminate your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll crush your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll put a stop to your ambitions!!!
Beryudora... no, Regis!!! We'll put a stop to your ambitions!!!
Gwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah...
Regis...!! You're still...!!
...Ugh... Regis is... This body of mine is crumbling...
You too will soon... be drawn back to your original worlds...
But do not think that this is the end...!!
Your worlds are filled with strife... Pain and hatred never cease,
and Minus Energy only grows and grows...
Ugly conflicts that wear the mask of justice and noble causes, steeped in vanity and greed...
Evil is far purer and more beautiful than that...
So long as the world does not change, such folly will be repeated... and one day...
another being of pure evil like me will be born...
It's true that negative emotions may never disappear...
But we have righteous hearts, and comrades and brothers who fight alongside us!
As long as we have the hearts and bonds we kept even after losing our power, we will never fall!
Whatever hardships stand in our way from now on, we will overcome them!
It's true negative emotions may never vanish... But even if hardships like this one come again,
we have hearts that love justice, and comrades who fight alongside us!
with the hearts we kept even after losing our power, we'll rise again as often as it takes,
and stand against them without ever giving up!!
It's true that the darkness in people's hearts may never disappear...
But we have hearts that believe in the future, and comrades who fight alongside us!
With our hearts' light, kept even after losing our power, we'll rise again as often as it takes!
So however often darkness breeds threats, everyone's hearts and wisdom can overcome them!
It's true that negative emotions may never disappear...
But we have righteous hearts, and comrades and brothers who fight alongside us!
As long as we have the hearts and bonds we kept even after losing our power, we will never fall!
Whatever hardships stand in our way from now on, we will overcome them!
Negative emotions will surely never disappear. But even if hardships like this one come again,
we have hearts that love justice, and comrades who fight alongside us!
No matter why we lose our strength, we will never lose this power!!
That's why, even if hardships stand in our way again, we can overcome them!
Not every negative emotion will ever disappear from us...
But my comrades' wills are watching over me! I'm not alone!
You'll never get it, Regis! This bond's power flowing through my body, kept even when I lost all!
Even if malice fills the world again, I believe we can change it!
It's true that negative emotions may never disappear...
But we have righteous hearts, and comrades and brothers who fight alongside us!
As long as we have the hearts and bonds we kept even after losing our power, we will never fall!
Whatever hardships stand in our way from now on, we'll overcome them, count on it!
Oi, oi, you're sure runnin' your mouth! Whatever happens from here on out! I'm gonna, uh... um...
Sempai, you should think before you talk...
It's the power of bonds! We all band together and fight! You'll cry!
If anything happens again, we'll come running, okay? ...I don't care about your answer!
You guys! I'm tryin' to wrap this up all cool, so quit gettin' in my waaay!!!
It's true that the negativity in our hearts will never vanish, and new threats may arise again.
But we've got hot hearts burning for what's right! And bonds with the comrades who fight beside us!
With this power we kept even after losing everything, we'll overcome any hardship...
and stand in the way of every new threat! In the name of the King of Hearts!
...It's true that negative emotions may never disappear...
But we won't give up!! We have hearts that burn for justice!
We'll turn the hearts we kept, even powerless, into strength, and rise again as often as it takes!
Whatever hardships await us from here on, that's how we'll keep moving forward!
Sure, negative emotions won't just go away, and a case like this one might come along again.

notes.note: Rows #274-284 are never played: 0736.bla has no MessWinSet for the #270-284 'prove it' block (nor #254-268). Voiced by wording and by the chain-3 order used for #286-300 (#274 Rider 1, #275 Zero, #276 Mebius, #277 Taro, #278 Seven, #279 Ultraman, #280 00, #281 Wing Zero, #282 God Gundam, #283 Zeta, #284 Nu). Subject unmarked; rendered 'I'll' (volitional of the speaking hero); 'that' = their claim that evil's power is a sham.

#286-300 = MessWinSet(TextIdOffset+285+R2), R2 from the 3rd Pt_Chara_Check chain (5,4,3,2,1,15,14,13,12,11,10,9,8,7,6): OOO, W (Shotaro), Den-O Sword Form, Black RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, 00, Wing Zero, God Gundam, Zeta, Nu. Extracted '?party' label only on #286; all 15 are leader variants. Same English where lines differ only in the pronoun for 'we'.
Ankh (CHARA_NAME 36) confirmed by script; deliberately unfinished ('You're still [alive]...').
Regis refers to itself in the third person and breaks off ('Regis is...'); kept the broken phrasing rather than guessing the missing verb.
Nameless (CharaNameOut before it); plays after the explosion fade-in. Silence.

#317-379 = leader blocks picked by the 4th chain (11,1,6,12,2,7,13,3,8,14,4,9,15,5,10): #317-320 Ultraman, #321-324 Rider 1, #325-328 Nu Gundam, #329-332 Seven, #333-336 Black RX, #337-340 Zeta, #341-344 Taro, #345-349 Den-O group (fixed names), #351-354 God Gundam, #355-358 Mebius, #359+ W. Extracted labels ('?party' on #317-320, none after) are wrong/missing; corrected here.
Rider 1's sentence runs across #321-324; English cut at matching points.
Nu Gundam (Amuro). 'Negative heart' rendered 'the darkness in people's hearts'; 'light of the heart' kept as 'light in our hearts' (CCA nod).
Black RX: lose our strength (battle power) vs never lose 'this power' (the heart); split strength/power to keep the contrast.

Zeta (Kamille) echoes his line 'You'll never understand... the power that flows through my body!'. JP: Regis could never understand this power of connection flowing out through my body, which I did not lose even after losing [my power]. 'Kept even when all else was lost' compresses 'did not lose even after losing'. Long row; check width.
Subject of 'can change it' unmarked; rendered 'we'.
Taro's version differs from Ultraman/Seven only by a casual sentence-final particle; only the tail differs in English.
Kintaros 'nakeru de' rendered with glossary catchphrase 'You'll cry!'.
Ryutaros: subject of 'come running' unmarked; 'we' (the Den-O group). Catchphrase per glossary.
Mebius: subject of 'won't give up' unmarked; 'we' to match the following 'we have hearts'.
W (Shotaro) confirmed (CHARA_NAME 4); Philip answers in story_176 #360.

report: 80/80 rows. Speakers verified against 0736.bla. #274-284 never played (no MessWinSet for that block); voiced by inferred chain-3 order. #286-300 chain 3; #317-379 chain 4 (Ultraman, Rider 1, Nu, Seven, RX, Zeta, Taro, Den-O group, God Gundam, Mebius, W). Extracted ?party/None labels corrected in notes. #306 Regis line breaks off ('Regis is...') kept. No new names or terms.
